name: After § 12
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 12a. Calls for the establishment of a transparent, permanent governance structure for the Clean Industrial Deal and its implementation, ensuring the structured and meaningful involvement of social partners – including trade unions – at EU, national, regional and sectoral levels in all of the Member States; stresses that this participatory governance must embed the partnership principle and allow workers’ representatives to contribute to both the design and monitoring of industrial transition pathways and funding programmes;
